title: A warmed API token remains usable after revocation
expected: The next request using a revoked PAT returns 401.
actual: The revoke response and token listing show revoked=true, but the next authenticated request returns 200. An unused revoked token is correctly rejected.
cause: ApiTokenService.revoke_token does not invalidate TOKEN_CACHE. validate_token checks the cached revoked flag, then reloads the DB row without rechecking revocation. Cache TTL defaults to 60 seconds.

title: Inactive users can authenticate with PATs on the profile endpoint
expected: Authentication rejects inactive users with 401 or 403.
actual: GET /users/me/profile returns 200 and a profile containing isActive=false when authenticated with the inactive user's PAT.
cause: get_current_user_by_api_token returns token.user without enforcing active status. JWT authentication and project permission checks enforce active status separately.

title: The SDK parses project blob downloads as JSON
actual: The backend correctly returns binary bytes with application/octet-stream, but the SDK raises JSONDecodeError.
cause: HttpRequestExecutor._parse_response calls response.json() before checking whether spec.response_model is FileDownloadResponse. Project blob downloads have no Content-Disposition header to trigger the earlier file branch.

title: Deleting a step artifact leaves its metadata in ClickHouse
expected: Deleted step artifacts disappear from the metadata index and UI queries.
actual: Deletion succeeds, but get-at-step still returns the deleted blob's metadata after bounded polling.
cause: ExperimentArtifactsService.delete_experiment_artifact_by_hash only calls object storage; it does not remove artifacts_info rows from the scalars service.

title: Missing experiment blobs return an internal server error
expected: Downloads of missing or deleted blobs return 404.
actual: Object storage returns 500 for a missing experiment blob, and downloading a deleted step artifact propagates 500 through the backend.
cause: The experiment download route does not translate missing S3 objects/buckets into a not-found response.

title: A nonexistent experiment returns 400 instead of the documented 404
actual: The API returns 400 with an Object with id ... not found message.
cause: The experiment controller maps DBNotFoundError through its generic 400 branch.

title: Reading another user's experiment metrics returns 400 instead of access denial
expected: The inaccessible experiment's metrics return 403 or the documented 404.
actual: The API denies the data but responds 400 with Project ... not accessible.
cause: get_experiment_metrics passes ProjectNotAccessibleError to the experiment controller's generic 400 branch.

title: Hypothesis cards navigate to a missing details page
expected: Clicking a hypothesis card opens a page showing that hypothesis.
actual: The card links to /projects/{project_id}/hypotheses/{hypothesis_id}, which returns the Next.js 404 page. The list itself and the backend hypothesis API work.
cause: HypothesisCard uses FRONTEND_ROUTES.PROJECT_PAGES.HYPOTHESIS_BY_ID, but the application only defines the hypotheses list route; no details route exists.
